candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because the order service returns 502, which traces show originates from payment returning 503 on POST /v1/authorizations; inventory/reservations succeed (200). The failure is a downstream server error surfaced as 5xx at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side cause (config, saturation, dependency) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 caused by order 502, which is caused by payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed. Gateway logs and metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout. Root cause is a downstream 5xx at payment, but payment-side evidence is absent, so the specific cause is bounded only to http-500.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/traces explaining the 503 on /v1/authorizations
Payment service metrics (error rate, saturation, dependency latency)
Order service logs/traces for the 502 propagation path
